SendWhisper.description: Sends a private Twitch whisper to someone. Your bot account sends it when one is signed in, otherwise your broadcaster account. Set bot to false to always use the broadcaster.
SendWhisper.returns: true when Twitch took the whisper (Twitch may still drop it quietly), false when the name or message is empty or it failed.
SendWhisper.example:
bool sent = CPH.SendWhisper("CoolViewer", "Thanks for the raid!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Whisper sent: {sent}");

TwitchAnnounce.description: Posts a highlighted announcement in your Twitch chat. Colours: default, blue, green, orange or purple. Your broadcaster account always sends it; bot and fallback are ignored.

TwitchGetBroadcaster.description: Gets your own Twitch account (the broadcaster account you signed in with): its id, login and display name.
TwitchGetBroadcaster.returns: Your account details, or null (nothing) when Twitch is not signed in.
TwitchGetBroadcaster.example:
var me = CPH.TwitchGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Signed in as {me.UserName}");

TwitchGetBot.description: Gets your Twitch bot account: its id, login and display name.
TwitchGetBot.returns: The bot account details, or null (nothing) when no bot account is signed in.
TwitchGetBot.example:
var bot = CPH.TwitchGetBot();
if (bot != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Bot is {bot.UserName}");

TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin.description: Looks up a Twitch user by their login name (an @ in front is fine). Also says whether Cuebot has seen them as a sub, mod or VIP in chat.
TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin.returns: The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.
TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin.example:
var user = CPH.TwitchGetUserInfoByLogin("CoolViewer");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{user.UserName} has id {user.UserId}");

TwitchGetUserInfoById.description: Looks up a Twitch user by their user id (a number given as text). Also says whether Cuebot has seen them as a sub, mod or VIP in chat.
TwitchGetUserInfoById.returns: The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.
TwitchGetUserInfoById.example:
var user = CPH.TwitchGetUserInfoById("123456789");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Found {user.UserName}");

TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin.description: Looks up lots about a Twitch user by login: bio, profile picture, game, stream title, account age, and whether they follow or subscribe (when Cuebot has permission to see that).
TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin.returns: The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.
TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin.example:
var user = CPH.TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoByLogin("CoolViewer");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{user.UserName} last played {user.Game}");

TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById.description: Looks up lots about a Twitch user by user id: bio, profile picture, game, stream title, account age, and whether they follow or subscribe (when Cuebot may see that).
TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById.returns: The user's details, or null (nothing) when there is no such user or Twitch did not answer.
TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById.example:
var user = CPH.TwitchGetExtendedUserInfoById("123456789");
if (user != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Follows you: {user.IsFollowing}");

TwitchTimeoutUser.description: Times a Twitch user out of chat for a number of seconds, with an optional reason. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.
TwitchTimeoutUser.returns: true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty (a warning goes in the log).
TwitchTimeoutUser.example:
bool done = CPH.TwitchTimeoutUser("SpamBot123", 600, "Spamming links");
CPH.LogInfo($"Timed out: {done}");

TwitchBanUser.description: Bans a Twitch user from your chat, with an optional reason. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.
TwitchBanUser.returns: true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty (a warning goes in the log).

TwitchUnbanUser.description: Lets a banned or timed-out Twitch user chat again. Your broadcaster account does it; useBot is ignored.
TwitchUnbanUser.returns: true when it worked, false when Twitch refused or the name is empty.

TwitchRunCommercial.description: Runs an ad break on your Twitch channel. The length is in seconds, from 30 to 180; other numbers are moved into that range.
TwitchRunCommercial.returns: true when the ad started, false when Twitch refused.

CreateStreamMarker.description: Puts a marker at this moment of your Twitch stream, with a short note, so you can find it later when making highlights. Only works while you are live.
CreateStreamMarker.returns: The marker (its id, note and how many seconds into the stream it is), or null (nothing) when Twitch refused.
CreateStreamMarker.example:
var marker = CPH.CreateStreamMarker("Epic boss fight");
if (marker != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Marker at {marker.Position} seconds");

CreateClip.description: Makes a Twitch clip of your live stream. Twitch picks the clip's length and title; a title you give is only copied into the result, and the duration is ignored.
CreateClip.returns: The clip (with its link and edit link), or null (nothing) when Twitch refused, for example while you are offline.
CreateClip.example:
var clip = CPH.CreateClip();
if (clip != null) CPH.SendMessage($"Clip: {clip.Url}");

SetChannelTitle.description: Changes the title of your Twitch stream.
SetChannelTitle.returns: true when it worked, false when the title is empty or Twitch refused.
SetChannelTitle.example:
bool done = CPH.SetChannelTitle("Speedrun practice! !discord");
CPH.LogInfo($"Title changed: {done}");

SetChannelGame.description: Changes the category (game) of your Twitch stream, found by its name, like "Just Chatting".
SetChannelGame.returns: The category it picked (its name and id), or null (nothing) when the name is empty or no category matches.
SetChannelGame.example:
var game = CPH.SetChannelGame("Minecraft");
if (game != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Category is now {game.Name}");

YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast.description: Gets the newest YouTube broadcast (live stream) Cuebot is watching: its title, link, status and chat id.
YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast.returns: The broadcast, or null (nothing) when Cuebot is not watching any.
YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast.example:
var stream = CPH.YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast();
if (stream != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Live on YouTube: {stream.Title}");

YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast.description: Gets the newest YouTube broadcast Cuebot is watching. Works the same as YouTubeGetLatestMonitoredBroadcast.
YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast.returns: The broadcast, or null (nothing) when Cuebot is not watching any.
YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast.example:
var stream = CPH.YouTubeGetLatestBroadcast();
if (stream != null) CPH.LogInfo(stream.Url);

YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts.description: Lists every YouTube broadcast (live stream) Cuebot is watching right now.
YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts.returns: A list of broadcasts, or an empty list when there are none.
YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts.example:
var streams = CPH.YouTubeGetMonitoredBroadcasts();
CPH.LogInfo($"Watching {streams.Count} YouTube broadcast(s)");

KickGetBroadcaster.description: Gets your own Kick account (the broadcaster you signed in with): its name, login, id and channel name in the web link (slug).
KickGetBroadcaster.returns: Your account details, or null (nothing) when Kick is not signed in.
KickGetBroadcaster.example:
var me = CPH.KickGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Kick channel: {me.ChannelSlug}");

KickGetBot.description: Gets your Kick bot account: its name and id.
KickGetBot.returns: The bot account details, or null (nothing) when no bot account is signed in.
KickGetBot.example:
var bot = CPH.KickGetBot();
if (bot != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Kick bot: {bot.UserName}");
